correctness.rationale: The focal 33-page preprint defines a leaf projection P using normalization phi_t(0)=t (section 3.3.1) and equivariance P o f=psi o P. Since f is area preserving, nu=P_*(Lebesgue area) is invariant under psi. For a short oriented parameter interval I=[s,t], P^-1(I) is a strip between ordered graph leaves, whose area is int_0^1(phi_t(x)-phi_s(x)) dx. The source Definition (8), page 28 formula (59), compares this gap to t-s between factors K_Fol^-1 and K_Fol at each x. Hence nu gives all arcs two-sided density bounds, so its cumulative-distribution lift H is bi-Lipschitz. Invariance implies H(psi(t))-H(t) constant (mod integer), forcing conjugacy to rotation by the irrational rotation number alpha established in Proposition 3.16. The exact remaining bi-Lipschitz conjugacy hypothesis in Theorem C is fulfilled, so f minimal. Wraparound arcs lifted periodically; leaves have zero area; no claim foliation Lipschitz follows automatically.
